speaker: Doctor
text: How long have you been experiencing the pruritic rash and the numbness in your palms?

speaker: Patient
text: 50-year-old male. The patient reports a year-long history of an itchy rash on his upper body and face. Additionally, he has been experiencing a numbness and tingling sensation on both palms. He has been working on his family's rice farm, also caring for livestock.

speaker: Doctor
text: That occupation is significant; are you wearing gloves when handling livestock or farm chemicals? Also, do you have any history of asthma or allergies? REQUEST TEST: Complete_Blood_Count, Liver_Function_Tests.

speaker: Doctor
text: Given your normal blood work and history with livestock and rice farming, I need to determine if this is a specific toxin exposure or an allergic reaction. Are you exposed to any specific plants, insects, or pesticides while working on the farm? REQUEST TEST: Heavy_Metal_Screening.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Porphyria Cutanea Tarda. The combination of a pruritic rash on sun-exposed areas, sensory changes in the palms, and your occupation with livestock and chemicals (which can induce porphyria) despite normal CBC and liver function points to this diagnosis, likely exacerbated by iron overload or hepatotoxic agents. REQUEST IMAGES: Skin_biopsy showing subepidermal bullae and clefting.
